titulo: Clear Answers About Taxes and SUNAT Compliance
subtitulo: Everything you need to know about 4th and 5th categories, withholding suspensions, tax deductions, and audit defense.
side_desc: Contact us via WhatsApp to review your tax status at our Surquillo office or via online consultation nationwide across Peru.
ws_msg: Hello Lourdes, I have a tax inquiry regarding my situation with SUNAT.

faqs.pregunta: At what amount is the 8% 4th-category tax withheld?
faqs.respuesta: If you issue an Electronic Fee Receipt (RHE) to a company exceeding S/ 1,500, the company is required to withhold 8% income tax, unless you have obtained an official Withholding Suspension Certificate (Form 1609).

faqs.pregunta: How and when should I file for Withholding Suspension (Form 1609)?
faqs.respuesta: This procedure is completed online through SUNAT Operaciones en Línea when you project that your annual 4th and 5th category earnings will not exceed SUNAT's legal threshold for the tax year (approx. S/ 45,063). We file your certificate promptly so you receive your full fee payments without unnecessary deductions.

faqs.pregunta: How does the additional 3 UIT deduction work to claim tax refunds?
faqs.respuesta: Every worker in 4th or 5th categories receives an automatic 7 UIT deduction, plus up to 3 additional UITs supported by electronic invoices bearing their DNI: restaurants/bars (15%), hotels (15%), independent professional services (30%), and domestic worker healthcare contributions (100%). This generates credit balances eligible for direct bank account refunds.

faqs.pregunta: What should I do if I receive an audit notice in my SUNAT SOL mailbox?
faqs.respuesta: Do not ignore the deadline. Inductive letters or formal citations frequently stem from bank transfer cross-checks (ITF) or payroll discrepancies. As a former SUNAT auditor, we examine the technical file, determine the issue, and prepare an evidentiary response before it turns into a fine or full tax audit.

faqs.pregunta: What makes Estudio Cusihuaman different from a general accountant?
faqs.respuesta: We specialize strictly in Personal Income Taxes (4th and 5th categories) and SUNAT tax audits. Having served inside the tax agency, we understand the exact detection routines, cross-referencing criteria, and legal interpretations used by tax auditors.
